checks.requirement: Bounded live-table pressure and retention sizing
Native archive, stable scoped replay identity, transaction races and rollback
Populated core upgrade and fresh restore above the old history cap
Independently reviewed cutoff, bounded batch, lost-result reconciliation and resumability
Paginated native status, current actor/workspace/site isolation and aggregate alerts
Event replay boundary and compact consumed-effect and subscription identity
Measured selection plans, lock duration and paired native web latency during cleanup

qualification_boundary: Disposable single-host reference workloads with reviewed cleanup. Native transaction effects and their receipts are coordinated with the database. External-effect cleanup is refused by this policy. Deployment resizing and sustained application-specific arrivals remain BX-02 and BX-04 work.
